OPL2007.title: Oplustil et al.2007 Pennsylvanian plant assemblages
OPL2007.note: Primary text and actual PlateVIII3 printedp145 personally inspected. O. feistmantelii long fertile axis with small rounded sporangial traces, lower shed region; not wagneri and not a whole tree. Filename plate7 contains printedp143 caption/table, not actual PlateVII photo, and is excluded. Copyright Elsevier; consult-only not incorporated/redistributed.

THOMAS2020.title: Thomas et al.2019 online/2020 The distribution of plant fossils and their palaeoecology, Brymbo
THOMAS2020.note: Actual full publisher text section3.2.4 read through web tool, not search summary. Omphalophloios several dichotomies, long grasslike laminae, oval sporangia and bottom-up shedding. Described species is feistmantelii. Figure/full-PDF download403, pixels NOT seen. Consult-only.

OPL2019.title: Oplustil et al.2019 Omphalophloios wagneri
OPL2019.note: Original inventory retained; publisher full page/full paper inaccessible403/429. Indexed abstract/search text only, NOT primary full-text inspection. At leastfive bifurcation orders and dense crown reported in index. No figure pixels seen and no species measurements used. Substitute2007 fossil/2020 primary text support genus-only scope.

PIGG1983.title: Pigg and Rothwell1983 Chaloneria Gen. Nov.; Heterosporous Lycophytes
PIGG1983.note: Actual original publisher abstract personally read. Unbranched ca2m rounded rooting base; proximal vegetative ligulate microphylls grade fertile apex; alternating mega/micro regions, no cushions. Full paper403 and reconstruction image403, not seen. Consult-only.

PIGG1985.title: Pigg and Rothwell1985 Cortical development in Chaloneria cormosa
PIGG1985.note: Primary scanned text p545/p548 and actual Plate64 figs1–5 personally inspected. Oval leaf bases, vertically undulating cortical stripes, no diamond cushions. Plate64figs6–8 comparative other taxa not adopted. Consult-only copyright Palaeontological Association, not redistributed.

RICHTER1909.title: P.B.Richter1909 Beitrage zur Flora der unteren Kreide Quedlinburgs II Nathorstiana
RICHTER1909.note: Personally read printedp4 actual PDF8 pixels (local filename-p2 is inaccurate page label) and PlateX actual PDF21 photographs/casts. Short unbranched axis, narrow leaves with expanded bases, meridional basal depressions, root scars and roots. Historical reproductive interpretation speculative, not adopted. Public-domain1909 edition per BHL, nevertheless consult-only and not redistributed.

ALAGAPPA.title: Alagappa University Plant Diversity teaching module Fig12.20
ALAGAPPA.note: Secondary teaching text and actual Fig12.20 left Nathorstiana reconstruction personally inspected; right Stylites not used. Short stem, terminal quills, swollen ribbed base/rootlets, unknown sporophylls. Not an original fossil plate or proof of whole habit. Consult-only rights unspecified, no redistribution.

HERAK1965.title: Herak1965 Comparative studies of Triassic Dasycladaceae
HERAK1965.note: Primary description printedpp22–23 and actual PlateVI2–4 personally inspected. Annulated cylindrical thallus, lumen and radial pore canals. ExcludeVI1 old dolomitica later Kantia. Fine tuft microstructure not all resolved. Consult-only, rights unspecified; no redistribution.
